summary: __thiscall destructor for a pooled linked-list object. Walks the node chain from pool head at offset 0xEC, and for each node frees its data pointer (and, when the node flag byte at node+8 is set, the inner data pointer chain via the node data first field) before freeing the node struct itself. Afterwards zeros pool fields 0xEC/0xF0/0xF4/0xF8 and reinitializes the object via ConstructorWithVTableSet. Frees the object itself when flag a2 bit 0 is set.

operations.description: Read pool head pointer from offset 0xEC.
Walk the node chain while the current node pointer is non-zero.
Read node flag byte at node+8 that selects deep freeing.
Advance the walk to the next node via the pointer at node+4.
When the node flag byte is non-zero, free the node data and its inner data.
Read node data pointer (first field of node struct).
Only dereference/free node data when the data pointer is non-zero.
Only free inner data when its first field is non-zero.
Free inner data pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free node data block via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the node struct itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zero pool head field at offset 0xEC.
When flag a2 bit 0 is set, free the object itself.
Free the object memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf.

unresolved: The node next-pointer field at node+4 is not present in the packet field evidence set.
